source: 10-design-reference section 6; sizes are interior, width along the back wall by depth, in inches.

entries.name: Alcove shower
entries.needs: three walls and a door or curtain
entries.bestFor: budget, hall baths, the common tub-to-shower swap
entries.watchOut: a hinged door must swing out

entries.name: Walk-in with a fixed glass panel (doorless)
entries.needs: enough length that the spray stays in, a half wall or 3/8 in panel, slope to the drain
entries.bestFor: primary baths, easy cleaning, no door hardware
entries.watchOut: under 60 in long it splashes the floor

entries.name: Curbless (zero threshold)
entries.needs: a recessed subfloor or a linear drain at the back wall, 1/4 in per ft slope, a full waterproofing membrane, floor tile with DCOF 0.42 or better
entries.bestFor: aging in place, seamless floors, wet rooms
entries.watchOut: the floor has to drop 1 1/2 to 2 in or the drain goes linear; flag it to the contractor

entries.name: Corner neo-angle
entries.needs: two walls meeting in a corner, a five-sided base or tile
entries.watchOut: tight inside; the door opens out into the room

entries.name: Double (two person)
entries.needs: two heads or a head plus rain, a bench, two niches, a 48 in opening
entries.watchOut: two heads at 2.5 gpm need 5 gpm of hot water; check the water heater

entries.name: Steam shower
entries.needs: an enclosure to the ceiling with a transom, a 7 to 8 ft ceiling sloped 1 to 2 in per ft, non-porous surfaces, a vapor-proof light, a generator within 25 ft, 50 cfm or more of exhaust, a bench, sealed doors
entries.watchOut: ceiling height and slope decide it early; check with the generator maker

entries.name: Wet room
entries.needs: the whole zone waterproofed, the tub inside the glass, a linear drain, curbless
entries.bestFor: tub and shower together in a smaller primary
entries.watchOut: everything in the zone gets wet; storage goes outside it

entries.name: Tub and shower combination
entries.needs: an alcove, tempered glass or a curtain
entries.watchOut: 32 in and 36 in tubs feel very different; measure the door it has to come through
